comments: Automated checks only. The site states that automated testing finds only part of accessibility issues and that a manual audit is not included.
features: Free online check of a single web page, rendered in a real browser and tested with axe-core against automated WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A/AA rules. An assistant explains each issue in plain language. An optional paid report adds a printable PDF, a prioritised action plan and an accessibility statement draft. No account required.
title: AccessMandate website analysis
